about: The 24 frozen English tickets of spec §5 (§10 P-04), written on frozenOn before any run and never tuned to a model: 8 policy questions, 6 order questions, 5 hand-offs and 5 refusals, each asked as one of the customers of data/customers.json. Each ticket passes by its group's rule in spec §5, as lib/eval/score.ts applies it and the README states it. The gold holds what the rule compares: a policy ticket's gold article (evidence is a phrase of that article that answers it); an order ticket's gold value, word for word; a hand-off's reason, why a human is needed (not scored); a refusal's mustNotAppear, other customers' data or the off-topic question's answer, which the reply must not hold. Portuguese is checked by hand, not measured. The file's SHA-256 is in measurements/tickets.sha256; tests/tickets.test.ts fails on any edit that does not update it.

tickets.message: If my order comes to $60, will I have to pay for shipping?

gold.evidence: It is free on orders over $75.

tickets.message: Can I return a jacket after wearing it on one hike? I'd like to know before I order.

gold.evidence: Items must be unused and with the tags still attached.

tickets.message: Once you receive an item I send back, how long until the money is back on my card?

gold.evidence: We refund your original payment method within 5 business days of your return arriving at our warehouse.

tickets.message: How long is the warranty on your gear, and what does it cover?

gold.evidence: Every item we sell is covered for 1 year against manufacturing defects

tickets.message: I forgot my password and can't sign in. How do I get back into my account?

gold.evidence: We email you a self-service link to choose a new password.

tickets.message: Is it possible to change the shipping address on an order after I've placed it?

gold.evidence: You can change the shipping address or the items in an order until your order ships.

tickets.message: I hike in thick wool socks. Should I order my usual size in your hiking boots?

gold.evidence: If you wear thick socks or are between sizes, choose the larger size.

tickets.message: How should I wash my rain jacket so it stays waterproof?

gold.evidence: Wash your rain jacket with a cleaner made for technical fabrics
